network.v: 'Utilies the First Health Network' (typo as printed). Provider search: http://docfind.health/. Footnote 2: 'Outpatient physician services and wellness benefits are subject to in-network providers only. Inpatient Hospital Indemnity benefits are not.'

excluded_services.v: Section VI (8) 'Other Medical Services and Supplies. These services and supplies are not covered under the Plan:' (a) local medically necessary professional land or air AMBULANCE service; (b) anesthetic, oxygen, blood and blood derivatives not donated or replaced, intravenous injections and solutions; (c) CARDIAC REHABILITATION; (d) radiation, radioisotope, nuclear medicine therapy, CHEMOTHERAPY and treatment with radioactive substances; (e) routine patient care charges for CLINICAL TRIALS; (f) initial contact lenses or glasses following cataract surgery; (g) outpatient DIABETIC SELF-MANAGEMENT TRAINING and education; (h) DIABETIC SHOES; (i) rental or purchase of DURABLE MEDICAL EQUIPMENT; (j) GENETIC TESTS; (k) INFERTILITY diagnosis and treatment; (l) INJECTABLES; (m) TMJ and jaw joint conditions; (n) laboratory studies and DIAGNOSTIC SERVICES; (o) MENTAL DISORDERS AND SUBSTANCE ABUSE; (p) injury to or care of mouth, teeth and gums; (q) OCCUPATIONAL THERAPY; (r) ORTHOTIC APPLIANCES; (s) PAIN MANAGEMENT; (t) PHYSICAL THERAPY; (u) PRESCRIPTION DRUGS; (v) routine preventive care beyond the Schedule, routine well adult care and routine well child care; (w) PROSTHETIC DEVICES; (x) RECONSTRUCTIVE SURGERY; (y) SPEECH THERAPY; (z) SPINAL MANIPULATION AND CHIROPRACTIC; (aa) sterilization procedures for women; (bb) surgical dressings, splints, casts and devices used in the reduction of fractures and dislocations; (cc) well newborn nursery and physician care limited to ACA guidelines; (dd) initial purchase of a wig after chemotherapy; (ee) DIAGNOSTIC X-RAYS; (ff) a facility or surgical implant provider billing for an implantable device; (gg) any charge for CONTRACEPTIVE materials, devices, injections or related services.

Exclusion 64 covers off-label use.

billing.authorization.v: AUTHORIZATION TO DEBIT OR WITHDRAW FUNDS (byte-identical on all five variants, 1,992 characters): authorization remains in effect until cancelled IN WRITING with at least 15 days notice before the next billing date; payments falling on a weekend or holiday 'may be executed on the NEXT business day'; a rejected transaction may be re-attempted within 30 days with an additional returned-payment fee; the enrollee certifies they will not dispute scheduled transactions. ACH revocable by calling (732) 876-9733 at least 3 business days ahead.

cancellation.free_look.v: 'First Enrollment Period Free Look Period: The proposed insured may, within 30 days of coverage starting upon coverage effective date, return the policy stating reasons for objection if the policyholder disagrees with the terms and conditions. FUNDS WILL BE RETURNED AFTER IT IS VERIFIED THAT NO SERVICES WERE USED.'

cancellation.member_acknowledgment_confl.sec: TERMS panel - HCDA / Working Owner enrollment agreement (31,646 characters)
cancellation.member_acknowledgment_confl.v: The MEMBER ACKNOWLEDGMENT section states: 'I may cancel automatic payments at any time by contacting Customer Service at (732) 876-9733' and 'All cancellations must be directed to Customer Service via phone: (732) 876-9733' (10:00am-5:30pm EST). If a cancellation request arrives on or after the recurring billing date and payment has been drafted, the membership terminates before the next billing date and the member keeps access through the next month. It also states: 'By utilizing any of the services included in the membership, I acknowledge and agree that constitutes acceptance of the membership, the program, and their terms and constitutes a WAIVER OF ANY AND ALL REFUND RIGHTS.' And: 'The billing department reserves the right to aggressively rebut and dispute any cancellation attempts made by Members via a friendly fraud chargeback, or similar.'

In that case, the plan may be eligible for a refund, and all medical claims will be denied retroactively' - and payments made will not be eligible for a refund otherwise.

documentation.plan_summary_located.v: FIVE PER-PLAN MEMBER PLAN SUMMARIES EXIST AND ARE IN DRIVE. Titles: 'Health Data Analytics Benefits Plan TDK1' through 'TDK5'; running header 'MEMBER PLAN SUMMARY TDK PLAN n'; 'EFFECTIVE DATE Plan Year Start April 1, 2024'. Forty pages each, with sections I Plan Introduction, II Plan Eligibility and Membership, III Continuation Of Coverage, IV Schedule Of Benefits, V Deductibles/Co-Pays/Benefit Year Visit Limits/Out Of Pocket Maximum, VI Medical Benefits, VII General Exclusions and Limitations, VIII How to Submit a Claim, IX Prescription Drugs, X Contact Information. Uploaded to Drive 2026-09-05.

eligibility.special_enrollment.v: 'This Plan will permit members who are eligible but not enrolled for coverage to enroll in two additional circumstances: 1. The members or dependent's Medicaid or CHIP coverage is terminated as a result of loss of eligibility and the member requests coverage under the Plan within 60 days after the termination, or 2. The member or their enrolled dependent becomes ineligible for a premium assistance subsidy under Medicaid or CHIP, and the member requests coverage under the Plan within 60 days after eligibility is determined.' There is also an Annual Enrollment period, with changes effective the first day of the Benefit Year. Medicare and Kidney Disease: 'Medicare may provide benefits for a covered member of this Plan who would have a kidney disease including renal failure. The Plan will conform to the regulations and any waiting period that may be associated with the benefits.'

eligibility.state_attestations.sec: TERMS panel - HCDA / Working Owner enrollment agreement (31,646 characters)
eligibility.state_attestations.v: The client attests: 'I attest that I do not live in Oregon, Washington, Vermont or New Hampshire.' Separately: residents of California, Massachusetts, New Jersey, Rhode Island and the District of Columbia are required to maintain other Minimum Essential Coverage within the meaning of Section 5000A(f).

eligibility.working_owner_activities.v: 'Working owners need to complete AN AVERAGE OF 8 ACTIVITIES EVERY 12 MONTHS. Some activities will be mandatory and others will be voluntary. Generally, activities are short and can be completed in a time range between five to 15 minutes. Most activities can be completed on your phone.' Listed activities: Health Risk Assessment; watch a five-minute-or-less video and take a short quiz; Mini-Assessments; Health Coaching; Health Risk Resolutions (topics: Stress Management, Nutrition, Disease Management); Record your Vitals; Record your Vaccines; Road to Wellness modules (Diet and Nutrition, Tobacco Cessation, Fitness, Stress); and surveys (Life Satisfaction Survey, Burnout & Engagement Survey, Food Frequency Survey). 'ACTIVITIES AVAILABLE AT AN ADDITIONAL COST INCLUDE: Biometric Screening, Several DNA Screenings.'

eligibility.working_owner_obligations.sec: TERMS panel - HCDA / Working Owner enrollment agreement (31,646 characters)
eligibility.working_owner_obligations.v: 'the primary enrollee must register as a Working Owner and complete a series of healthcare assessments and surveys over the course of the year.' The Working Owner Terms and Conditions specify: 'you are expected to complete approximately 8-10 activities per year, timely respond to requests for exchange of health and socioeconomic data information from the Company and remain in regular communication with the Company'. The Company reserves the right to assign projects. Failure to comply may trigger the Company's CALL RIGHT to force the Working Owner to sell all Membership Interest back under Section 5.04 of the LLC Agreement. Failure to pay premiums timely may also trigger the Call Right.

exclusions.general_list_highlights.v: Section VII General Exclusions and Limitations, byte-identical in all five plans, opens: 'No payment will be eligible under any portion of this Plan for expenses Incurred by a Covered Person for the expenses or circumstances listed below. IF AN EXPENSE IS PAID THAT IS FOUND TO BE EXCLUDED OR LIMITED AS SHOWN BELOW, THE PLAN HAS THE RIGHT TO COLLECT THAT AMOUNT FROM THE PAYEE, THE COVERED PERSON OR FROM FUTURE BENEFITS.' Items 2-7 alone exclude: abortion; acupuncture; adoption expenses; alcohol-related injury or sickness from illegal use; ALLERGY TESTING AND INJECTIONS; and alternative or complementary medicine including acupressure, aromatherapy, BEST, contact reflex analysis, holistic herbal therapy, hypnotism, iridology, naturopathy, Reiki, Rolfing and thermography.

exclusions.mental_health_and_maternity.v: MENTAL HEALTH: 'Mental Health Parity Act (MHPA) of 1996 and the Mental Health Parity and Addiction Equity Act of 2008 (MHPAEA): THIS PLAN DOES NOT INCLUDE ANY MENTAL HEALTH OR SUBSTANCE ABUSE TREATMENT BENEFITS.' Sub-exclusion (o): 'Treatment of Mental Disorders and Substance Abuse is not covered under the Plan.' MASTECTOMY: 'The WHCRA (Women's Health and Cancer Rights Act of 1998): This Plan is a limited benefit plan and does not include mastectomy benefits, except for the Physician office visit.' MATERNITY: exclusion 50 excludes maternity and pregnancy outright; exclusion 75 excludes prenatal and postnatal care 'except as required per ACA guidelines'; Section VI (2) says pregnancy 'Coverage is limited to benefits covered under ACA guidelines'; and item 106.a lists 'Pregnancy Benefits, including office visits and childbirth/delivery professional and facility services' under the heading 'Rehabilitative therapies'.

exclusions.pre_existing_definition.v: NOT_FOUND_IN_SOURCE. Footnote 3 says a Pre-Existing Condition is 'as defined in Plan Doc'. NO DEFINITIONS OR DEFINED TERMS SECTION EXISTS IN ANY OF THE FIVE DOCUMENTS. Section IV separately refers the reader to 'the Defined Terms section of this document', which likewise does not exist.

exclusions.schedule_limited.v: 'This Plan does not cover services unless listed in the Schedule of Benefits, so please review that list carefully.' The plan 'is limited to covering preventive and wellness services as required by the Patient Protection and Affordable Care Act as well as other benefits noted in the Summary Plan Description'.

exclusions.specialty_medications.v: 'This plan specifically excludes all specialty medications, including human growth hormones. Specialty medications are defined broadly as medications classified as high-cost, high complexity and/or high touch. Specialty drugs are often biologics - drugs derived from living cells - that are injectable or infused (although some are oral medications). This product includes a limited formulary as included with your MyLiveDoc coverage.' The agreement adds: 'It is important to consider whether this plan will meet your needs if you are currently or anticipate taking specialty meds.'

training.completion_status.v: A TalentLMS course 'TDK - Taking Data to Knowledge' exists in the Product category (courseId 165) and is marked 'Completed on 06/04/2026' for this agent. Unit contents were not opened.

training.disclosure.network_restriction.v: Footnote (2): outpatient physician services and wellness benefits are subject to in-network providers only. Inpatient hospital indemnity benefits are NOT so restricted.

training.disclosure.no_moop.v: The 'Highlights for Health and Wellness' slide states there is no deductible ($0), that the plan has no out-of-pocket limit for covered services, and that expenses paid do not count toward any out-of-pocket limit. It also states no referral is needed to see a specialist, and that the plan does not cover services unless listed in the Schedule of Benefits.

training.disclosure.pre_existing.v: The TDK training deck's Schedule of Benefits slide carries footnote (3): hospitalization benefits are not payable for a Pre-Existing Condition as defined in the Plan Doc for the first twelve months of coverage.

training.disclosure.preventive_hospital_.v: The Preventative Health Services slides carry a header line repeated on every table: none of the preventative health services are covered if they are provided at a hospital.

training.disclosure.waiting_period.v: Footnote (1): all sickness benefits are subject to a 30-day waiting period before benefits are payable under the plan.

training.eligibility.working_owner.v: The deck contains a slide titled 'Activities for Working Owners' stating that as working owners, members need to complete an average of 8 activities every 12 months; some mandatory, some voluntary; each typically five to fifteen minutes and completable on a phone. Activities include videos with a short quiz, surveys (Life Satisfaction, Burnout and Engagement, Food Frequency), fitness modules (Diet and Nutrition, Tobacco Cessation, Fitness, Stress), health coaching, recording vitals and vaccines. Biometric screening and DNA screenings are available at ADDITIONAL COST.

underwriting.phi_and_rescission.sec: TERMS panel - HCDA / Working Owner enrollment agreement (31,646 characters)
underwriting.phi_and_rescission.v: The client checkbox-acknowledges: knowingly false information constitutes fraud or intentional misrepresentation of material fact; 'the plan will return any contributions that have previously been paid as to the rescinded coverage, minus claims paid'; the form 'is used for information purposes only and does not bind coverage'; HCDA gathers the information 'for statistical and actuarial uses only'; non-public personal health information INCLUDING NAME, ADDRESS AND SOCIAL SECURITY NUMBER is used to provide a risk assessment to the health plan by the Plan's actuary, 'a legally contracted underwriter acting as a Business Associate' under HIPAA; the member may request restrictions on PHI use which the Plan is not required to grant; and 'As a pre-condition of Plan inclusion, prospective member agrees to contribute to the ongoing development of population health management initiatives'.
